activity.notes: Morenga commanded a coalition drawing on Nama and Herero communities against German colonial rule. This Activity covers the 1904–1906 campaign and ends before his detention in the Cape Colony. His resumed resistance in 1907 is separate; he is not represented as a hereditary king of all Herero.
